segments.caption: A motocross rider, viewed from a helmet-mounted camera, accelerates down a narrow, urban street lined with spectators and barriers, navigating a tight course past a parked car and through a series of turns, with a Red Bull logo visible on the front of the bike.
A motorcyclist races up a steep, narrow urban street lined with spectators, navigating a challenging course marked by barriers and red tape, with a Red Bull-branded helmet visible in the foreground.
A rider navigates a steep, narrow urban dirt track, maneuvering past crowds of spectators lining the route, before ascending a concrete staircase and continuing along a paved path.
A first-person view from a motorcycle speeding through a narrow, urban street lined with spectators and barriers, navigating turns and obstacles as part of a high-energy street race or stunt event.

A motocross rider speeds down a narrow, crowded urban street, navigating between spectators lining the sidewalks and walls, with the Red Bull logo visible on the front of the bike as the camera captures the high-speed descent.

A mountain biker races down a narrow, winding urban street, captured from a helmet-mounted camera. The rider navigates tight corners and steep descents, passing crowds of spectators lining the route and weaving through graffiti-covered alleyways. The Red Bull logo on the helmet’s visor confirms the high-energy, competitive nature of the ride, showcasing a thrilling descent through a vibrant, densely built environment.

A first-person view from a speeding rally car, branded with Red Bull, races through a narrow, cobblestoned street lined with cheering spectators behind barriers, navigating tight turns and passing a prominent Nissan sign before accelerating down a steep incline.

A first-person view from a speeding Red Bull motorcycle races down a narrow, crowded urban street, weaving past spectators and photographers lining the route, capturing the high-energy atmosphere of a street racing or stunt event.
